opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a source of real earnings and frames the material as payment proof, with the title explicitly stating “FORSAGE REAL EARNINGS.” It then uses wallet screens and transaction details, including a visible +800 TRX smart-contract transfer, alongside claims such as “Earned 2700 trx today,” to portray immediate, substantial returns as credible. Those purported receipts serve as promotional evidence for the earning opportunity while the video does not explain the underlying participation conditions or risks. The qualification that hard work does not guarantee success does not provide a substantive explanation of how the promoted Forsage earnings work or what viewers must undertake.
